questions.stem: 近年來，許多城市已多次被極端降雨淹沒，造成嚴重的交通混亂與財產損失。
questions.answer: In recent years, many cities have been flooded by extreme rainfall several times, causing serious traffic chaos and property damage.
accepted_answers: In recent years, many cities have repeatedly been flooded by extreme rainfall, resulting in serious traffic chaos and damage to property.
In recent years, many cities have been flooded by extreme rainfall time after time, leading to serious traffic chaos and property losses.

patterns: 句尾分詞片語表結果（, causing …）

questions.stem: 預測這種極端降雨比預測颱風困難得多，因為它可能在不到一小時內就形成。
questions.answer: Predicting such extreme rainfall is much more difficult than predicting typhoons, because it can form in less than an hour.
accepted_answers: Predicting this kind of extreme rainfall is far harder than predicting typhoons, because it may form in under an hour.
Forecasting such extreme rainfall is much more difficult than forecasting typhoons, since it can develop in less than an hour.

1.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已多次…」表示從過去到現在反覆發生，用現在完成式；城市是被淹沒的一方，用完成式被動 have been flooded by extreme rainfall（several times／repeatedly）。「造成…」是淹水的結果，用句尾分詞 , causing／resulting in／leading to …，分詞的邏輯主詞是前面整件事。「交通混亂與財產損失」寫成 traffic chaos and property damage，damage 不可數。
evidence: 已多次被極端降雨淹沒
造成嚴重的交通混亂與財產損失
1.strategy_zh: 「近年來已多次被…」→ have been p.p. … several times；「…，造成…」→ , causing + N。
hints: 切成四段：近年來，許多城市／已多次被極端降雨淹沒／造成／嚴重的交通混亂與財產損失
標的詞彙：recent（近來的）、city（城市）、flood（淹沒）、extreme（極端的）、rainfall（降雨）、serious（嚴重的）、traffic（交通）、chaos（混亂）、property（財產）、damage（損失）
句型框架：In recent years, S + have been p.p. by … several times, causing + N + and + N

2.explanation_zh: 「預測這種極端降雨」是動作當主詞，用動名詞片語 Predicting such extreme rainfall，動詞用單數 is。「比預測颱風困難得多」用比較級 much／far more difficult than …，than 後面也用動名詞 predicting typhoons，比較的對象才對等。「因為它可能在不到一小時內就形成」用 because it can form in less than an hour；form（形成）是不及物動詞。
2.strategy_zh: 「做 A 比做 B＋形容詞」→ V-ing A + is + 比較級 + than + V-ing B；比較級加強用 much／far。
hints: 切成四段：預測這種極端降雨／比預測颱風困難得多／因為它可能／在不到一小時內就形成
標的詞彙：predict（預測）、extreme（極端的）、rainfall（降雨）、difficult（困難的）、typhoon（颱風）、because（因為）、form（形成）、hour（小時）
句型框架：V-ing … + is much more + adj. + than + V-ing …, because + S + can + V …

references: In recent years, many cities have been flooded by extreme rainfall several times, causing serious traffic chaos and property damage.
In recent years, many cities have repeatedly been flooded by extreme rainfall, resulting in serious traffic chaos and damage to property.
In recent years, many cities have been flooded by extreme rainfall time after time, leading to serious traffic chaos and property losses.

patterns.label_zh: 完成式被動（已多次被…淹沒）
patterns.frame: S + have been + p.p. + by … (+ several times)
patterns.zh_trigger: 已多次被極端降雨淹沒

patterns.label_zh: 句尾分詞片語表結果（造成…）
patterns.zh_trigger: 造成嚴重的交通混亂與財產損失

accepted: In recent years, many cities
Over the past few years, many cities
Recently, many cities

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「近年來」是 in recent years，years 用複數。
many 後面接複數名詞 cities。

parts.zh: 已多次被極端降雨淹沒
accepted: have been flooded by extreme rainfall several times
have repeatedly been flooded by extreme rainfall
have been flooded by extreme rainfall time after time
have been flooded by extreme rainfall many times
have been flooded by extreme rainfall again and again

common_errors.wrong: have flooded by extreme rainfall several times
common_errors.right: have been flooded by extreme rainfall several times
common_errors.explanation_zh: 城市是「被」淹沒，完成式被動要有 been：have been flooded。

common_errors.wrong: have been drowned by extreme rainfall
common_errors.right: have been flooded by extreme rainfall
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「淹沒」城市、街道用 flood；drown 多指人或動物溺水。

accepted: causing
resulting in
leading to

common_errors.wrong: several times, caused serious traffic chaos
common_errors.right: several times, causing serious traffic chaos
common_errors.explanation_zh: 前面已是完整句子，表結果用句尾分詞 causing（或 resulting in／leading to）；caused 會變成第二個主要動詞卻沒有連接詞。
result 表「造成」時要接 in：resulting in …。

parts.zh: 嚴重的交通混亂與財產損失
accepted: serious traffic chaos and property damage
serious traffic chaos and damage to property
serious traffic chaos and property losses

common_errors.wrong: serious traffic chaos and property damages
common_errors.right: serious traffic chaos and property damage
common_errors.explanation_zh: damage 表「損害」時不可數，不加 s（damages 是「賠償金」）。
「交通混亂」是 traffic chaos；confusion 指人的困惑。

traps.zh: 已多次被極端降雨淹沒
traps.literal_error: many cities were flooded by extreme rainfall
traps.explanation_zh: 「近年來…已多次」表示從過去到現在反覆發生，用現在完成式被動 have been flooded；過去式看不出延續到現在。
「交通混亂」是抽象名詞，英文用 traffic chaos；寫成 the traffic very messy 少了動詞，也不是名詞片語。

bonus.text: Time and again in recent years, cities have been swamped by extreme rainfall, which has brought traffic to a standstill and caused heavy property damage.
bonus.explanation_zh: swamp（淹沒）、bring traffic to a standstill（讓交通停擺）是進階搭配；time and again（一再）放句首強調「多次」。這是加分寫法。

1.restructuring_zh: 「造成…」中文接在逗號後沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 causing … 表結果；「已多次被…淹沒」改成完成式被動 have been flooded … several times。

references: Predicting such extreme rainfall is much more difficult than predicting typhoons, because it can form in less than an hour.
Predicting this kind of extreme rainfall is far harder than predicting typhoons, because it may form in under an hour.
Forecasting such extreme rainfall is much more difficult than forecasting typhoons, since it can develop in less than an hour.

patterns.label_zh: 動名詞片語當主詞（預測…）
patterns.frame: V-ing … + is + 比較級 + than + V-ing …

patterns.label_zh: 比較級（比…困難得多：much more + adj. + than）
patterns.frame: A + is + much/far more + adj. + than + B

accepted: Predicting such extreme rainfall
Predicting this kind of extreme rainfall
Forecasting such extreme rainfall
To predict such extreme rainfall

common_errors.explanation_zh: 動作「預測…」當主詞要用動名詞 Predicting（或 To predict），原形動詞不能當主詞。
動名詞片語當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。

accepted: is much more difficult than predicting typhoons
is far harder than predicting typhoons
is much more difficult than forecasting typhoons
is much harder than predicting typhoons

common_errors.explanation_zh: 比較級前面加強語氣用 much／far／a lot，不能用 very。

common_errors.wrong: is much more difficult than predict typhoons
common_errors.right: is much more difficult than predicting typhoons
common_errors.explanation_zh: than 前後比較的對象要對等：Predicting … 對 predicting typhoons。

accepted: because it can
because it may
since it can
as it can

common_errors.explanation_zh: because of 後面接名詞；接子句（it can …）只用 because。
情態助動詞不能連用，may 和 can 擇一。

parts.zh: 在不到一小時內就形成
accepted: form in less than an hour
form in under an hour
develop in less than an hour
form within an hour

common_errors.right: form in less than an hour
common_errors.explanation_zh: 表示「在多少時間之內」要有介系詞 in／within。

common_errors.wrong: form in less than one hours
common_errors.right: form in less than an hour
common_errors.explanation_zh: less than an hour：「一小時」用單數 an hour。

traps.literal_error: Predict such extreme rainfall is more difficult …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文用動作「預測…」當主詞，英文要用動名詞 Predicting …（或 To predict …）。

traps.literal_error: … is very more difficult than predict typhoons
traps.explanation_zh: 「…得多」修飾比較級要用 much／far，不能用 very；than 後面也要用同樣的動名詞 predicting typhoons，比較的對象才對等。

bonus.text: Such extreme rainfall is far trickier to forecast than a typhoon, as it can build up in well under an hour.
bonus.explanation_zh: A is trickier to forecast than B（形容詞＋不定詞）把「預測」移到後面，句子更精簡；in well under an hour 強調「連一小時都不到」。這是加分寫法。

1.translation: In recent years, many cities have been repeatedly flooded by extreme rainfall, resulting in serious traffic chaos and property damage.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」配現在完成式；「已多次被…淹沒」用現在完成被動 have been repeatedly flooded by（也可 several times）；「造成…」是結果，用分詞 resulting in／causing；「財產損失」用 property damage（也可 property losses）。

2.translation: Predicting this kind of extreme rainfall is much more difficult than predicting typhoons because it can form in less than an hour.
2.explanation_zh: 「預測這種極端降雨」當主詞，用動名詞；「困難得多」用 much more difficult than，比較對象也用動名詞 predicting typhoons 保持對稱；「可能在不到一小時內就形成」用 can form in less than an hour。

1.translation: In recent years, many cities have been flooded repeatedly by extreme rainfall, causing serious traffic chaos and property damage.
1.explanation_zh: 「近年來」搭配現在完成式 have been flooded；「多次」用 repeatedly；「被極端降雨淹沒」用被動 flooded by extreme rainfall；「造成……」用現在分詞 causing 表結果。

2.translation: Predicting this kind of extreme rainfall is much more difficult than predicting typhoons because it can form in less than an hour.
2.explanation_zh: 「預測……」用動名詞 Predicting 當主詞；「比……困難得多」用 much more difficult than，than 後面用 predicting 保持平行；「因為它可能在不到一小時內形成」用 because it can form in less than an hour。
